objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-excessive-usage-of-net-app
objects.description: The following analytic detects excessive usage of `net.exe` within a one-minute interval. It leverages data from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on process names, parent processes, and command-line executions. This behavior is significant as it may indicate an adversary attempting to create, delete, or disable multiple user accounts rapidly, a tactic observed in Monero mining incidents.
